title: Collapsed messages are flat rows; open messages are raised cards
steps: Launch Mail with -UseFakeData; open a conversation with 4 or more messages
Move the pointer over a collapsed message, then over 'N older messages'
Press Up and Down to focus collapsed and open messages
Press R, then open Send later with the collapsed rows in view; then switch View › Appearance to Dark
expected: Collapsed messages are flat rows on the background (sender, snippet, date): no card, no lines; senders line up with the open message's sender. 'N older messages' starts in the sender column, so a sheet never leaves an empty-looking row. Hover lifts a row to a card and nothing moves. The focused message is a raised card with an accent bar; open messages are raised cards. Same in Dark.
